newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas volumes leap on after hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas volumes leap on after hours trade.

text.p: Trading volumes in British Gas leapt on Thursday as 100 million shares were traded after hours in what looked like a "bed and breakfast" deal, analysts said.
The trade was executed at 180p and took business in British Gas to over 119 million. The shares earlier closed at 189-1/2p, a rise of 1/2p on the day.

Bed and breakfasting involves the selling of shares shortly before the end of the tax year and buying them back again the following morning. The deal allows shareholders to register a capital loss or profit for tax purposes.
